criteria.contract: Add the cross-cutting scope of the adopted features (goods, NPC initiative, art assets and dialogue text, information spread, history-mode differences, load) to the affected existing items without changing the 60 items or weights; extend the field list with goods, organizations and definition tables.
Re-rate only the affected items downward in proportion to the added scope; record old and new percentages, the added scope and the reason for each item.
Record the total change as an excluded reassessment, never as earned implementation progress; no code, tests or assets change.
Re-freeze the next implementation stage (NPC purpose) on the fourth re-rated baseline before its code exists, keeping its per-item target increments.
Regenerate the progress view and pass the existing progress and approval-batch checks.
